title: Punctured-line constants, actual generator, and higher vanishing
statement: For a purity finite setting P, h : ramificationIndex divides level and any k-scheme Y with structure map a, the degree-zero cohomology map of the twisted punctured-line relativeUnit of [def-pur-relative-kummer-maps] and the specified kummerGenerator are isomorphisms. For each natural m >= 2, Hm of the derived direct image of the actual twist under the punctured projection is zero. This is the punctured-line part of clauses (1)-(3), independent of all base-change conclusions and of the affine-line acyclicity assertion.

proof.text: Put r = ell^(level/e). The finite Kummer-level theorem makes A finite free over Z/r and rA=0. If r=1 then A=0, so all objects are zero and the conclusions are immediate; otherwise level/e is positive. The exponent is invertible on every k-scheme. A primitive r-th root in k trivializes the actual root line, naturally under k-morphisms. This also handles constant degree-zero sections.

Use the natural module-to-abelian comparisons for cohomology and higher direct images. Injective module sheaves are acyclic after scalar forgetting, so the comparisons preserve actual maps. Pullback of units defines a morphism from the pulled-back Kummer sequence to the new Kummer sequence. Naturality of connecting maps and coefficient insertion therefore preserves the actual boundary of the coordinate.

Over k the punctured line is a smooth affine curve with Picard group zero and units k-units times integral powers of t. The Kummer long exact sequence identifies H1(mu_r) with Z/r generated by the boundary of t. Constant sections give H0. Affine-curve cohomological dimension kills degrees above one. Finite free coefficient extension tensors these calculations with A and preserves the specified boundary.

For each geometric point of an arbitrary base B, let S be its strict henselization. The punctured projection is affine and qcqs; the canonical stalk formula computes its higher-image stalk by cohomology of the punctured line over S. The higher-direct-image presheaf formula identifies the germ of the actual edge section with restriction of the coordinate class.

In the product square of the punctured line over k with S, apply smooth base change in the rotated direction: the smooth base-changing arrow is the curve over k, and the morphism S to Spec k is affine. Strictly henselian constant cohomology and stalk conservativity identify the pullback unit along the other projection as an isomorphism. Derived direct-image composition and the derived-unit pullback formula identify the resulting cohomology comparison with actual restriction from the curve over k. This restriction preserves constants and the coordinate boundary. These arguments impose no finite-type condition on S or B.

Geometric stalk conservativity now proves invertibility of the punctured degree-zero unit and the actual Kummer generator, and vanishing in every degree m >= 2. Exact etale/pro-etale comparison transports the vanishing. Its specified counit mate and the mate-unit identity transport the unit. The normalized comparison of global classes and edge sections transports the actual coordinate generator. Apply scalar forgetting conservativity where needed.
